source: Policy for growing a turbo stage map around the engine's air demand (physics_sim ps::drivetrain::meanline::ExtensionPolicy; owner rule 2026-10-14: turbo maps recompute and cache when out of range). Numbers are physics_sim's [AS] defaults: dense speed lines every 500 rpm [D] (the car_hyper_n2o demand at 1.8 bar sits 376 rpm above the choke edge), flow knots every 0.01 kg/s, margins 5 % in speed and 10 % in flow, budgets = the generator's adaptive budgets (129 speed lines, 257 flow points).

cache.subdir_help: Under the engine map cache directory; a file is turbo_stage_<cache key>.json, written atomically. The key is physics_sim's meanline::cache_key of geometry and extended axes, so equal demand = equal file.

choke.help: The choke message of the setup check: largest per-turbo flow at which the compressor still reaches the target pressure ratio, found by scanning corrected speed in rpm_step steps for the first valid point, bisecting onto the choke edge, and bisecting the flow up to the largest demand x flow_scan_max_factor.
